item.title: - Translation Operator
item.description: 1. Translational Symmetry in Space # The inner product between two states remains invariant under translation: $\langle\phi|\psi\rangle = \langle\phi|T^{\dagger}(\Delta x’)T(\Delta x)|\psi\rangle$ where $T(\Delta x’)|x’\rangle = |x’+\Delta x’\rangle$ Therefore, $T^{\dagger}(\Delta x’)T(\Delta x) = 1$ This means that $T(\Delta x’)$ is a unitary operator. 2. General Form of Unitary Operators # The general form of a unitary operator $U$ is: $U = e^{ik}$, where $k^{\dagger} = k$ 3.
